title: Stored lead ore carried from Node Beta to Sirius Observatory Station and sold into its bid at 35 cr or more
note: 2026-11-22 03:59 UTC (Mercury, orders.log ENT-061 block MERCURY and P5: sell routes for what the other divisions give Trade's receivers; Mining gives lead ore to the trader receivers, requests.log ENT-332). No home station bids for lead ore above 5 cr; Sirius Observatory Station bids 40 x 526 (its book read 03:49 UTC, data/market). Road: Node Beta, Node Alpha, Synchrony, Pherkad, GSC-0041, Antares, Homam, Furud, Nova Terra, Sirius (9 jumps, 3 lawless, no pirate on our record in 24 hours, data/intel/sightings.jsonl). About 2,600 cr a load of 65 before fuel. requires.stored opens it only to a pilot whose own storage holds a load. One ship (rule F37: one buyer, one ship three times).
